PR #584 (W17): (a) data/optional_variables.py defines one DERIVATION_REJECTED_EXIT (65); add_sst, add_evapduct, add_swell23, add_ctop, add_icing, add_cat, add_fog, add_thermals, add_soil, add_fire, add_dust, add_aero_o3 and add_aq turn their own input-plausibility failures (the old SANITY FAIL / assert / SystemExit checks, same bounds) into that status; (b) data/enrich_gfs.sh step() reads the status from optional_variables.py, clears a script's earlier receipts before each attempt (begin-attempt; if that fails the step is not run and counts as a failure), and only that status from a producer pinned in data/optional_variables.json becomes a typed derivation-rejected receipt in the run manifest's retiredVariables (logged '[enrich] REJECTED <script> (derivation-rejected receipt recorded)', not counted as a failure); any other non-zero status is '[enrich] FAIL <script> (exit N)'; the final line becomes '[enrich] done: N failure(s), N derivation(s) rejected with a receipt, N source outage(s) with a receipt'; (c) data/optional_variables.json (schema 3) moves aero, aqi, cat, ctop, dust, fire, fog, icing, o3, pm25, soil{f,m,t}_*, swell2, swell3, thermals from strictAtComponentGate to absenceReceipts (derivation-rejected, each with its producer), so ops/platform/validate-model-component.py publishes a GFS run that lacks one of them when its run-bound receipt is present, where it refused before ('candidate drops live variables'); capei, frzalt, dfm10, drought, uv and ECMWF upper air stay strict; the optional list itself (6 ECMWF, 32 GFS, read by ops/bake-weatherx.sh) is unchanged. PR #589 (W19): (d) data/source_transport.py classifies only an HTTP 5xx, a connection failure/timeout, or an OPeNDAP 5xx (an NC_EDAPSVC without a DAP error document, or an attribute-less DAS whose logged HTML page states a 5xx) as SourceUnavailable, exit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_EXIT (69); TLS, proxy, NC_EIO and 4xx stay failures; (e) only so2, o3surf, co and no2 (NASA GEOS-CF, hidden in the app) pin source-unavailable, so enrich_gfs.sh records '[enrich] SOURCE UNAVAILABLE <script> (source-unavailable receipt recorded)' for add_so2/add_geoscf; exit 69 from any other producer (an index or range 5xx in cat, fog, icing, thermals, soil, fire, sst, evapduct, swell23) is counted as a failure exactly as the crash it was on master; ctop, dust, aero/o3 and pm25/aqi keep master's unchecked index read (CLASSIFY_UNCHECKED_INDEX_READS false); (f) data/carry_static_addons.py gains --capture-last-good, which ops/bake-model-component.sh (gfs only) and ops/bake-weatherx.sh run before the core fetch to stash the hydrated runs' GEOS-CF static frames in data/.gfs-carry-last-good (git-ignored, outside app/public; a failure is logged and never blocks), and carry() also considers that stash; carry still copies an eligible last-good GEOS-CF frame whenever the field is missing, receipt or not, as on master, and replaces a GEOS-CF receipt bound to this run; RTOFS currents keep master's local-index carry; (g) the component gate accepts a GEOS-CF absence by reason: source-stale (date-verified, as before) or source-unavailable (run-bound); (h) ops/core_model_artifact.py: when a sealed collector artifact also holds an older run that is already hydrated (fetch.py's backfill), install keeps the hydrated, published copy instead of the bare re-fetch (the 2026-10-19 06Z 48 -> 21 variable shape); (i) add_fire.py and add_aero_o3.py stage frames in a candidate directory, so a failure part-way leaves no stray frames.
